MEDIA ABOUT US

Apr 2, 2025

Successful ERA Chair Kick-off Meeting – Thank You! 🎉

We are pleased to announce the successful completion of the Kick-off Meeting inaugurating the ERA Chair project, held on March 14, 2025. This event marked a significant milestone for our institute and the beginning of an ambitious scientific endeavour.

We extend our sincere gratitude to all participants, speakers and distinguished guests who joined us both in person and remotely. Your valuable contributions, insightful discussions, and engagement made this event a truly memorable occasion.

The ERA Chair project opens new opportunities for scientific collaboration and innovation, and we look forward to the exciting developments ahead.

Thank you for being part of this important moment, and we invite you to stay connected for future updates.

Apr 1, 2025

🎬 Watch Prof. Artur Ekert’s Lecture! 🔐✨

On March 13, 2025, a fascinating lecture by Prof. Artur Ekert, one of the pioneers of quantum cryptography, took place at the Centrum Nauki Kopernik.

Why should data security be grounded in the laws of physics rather than just mathematical puzzles?

Find out in the recording: youtube.com

Apr 1, 2025

Our Work in the Spotlight! We are pleased to share that Academia PAN has published an article about our project funded by the ERA Chairs grant. This initiative, carried out at the Center for Theoretical Physics PAS, aims to strengthen research potential and foster international collaboration.

Read more about it here: academia.pan.pl

We extend our gratitude to everyone involved in this project - this is a significant step forward for our institution.
